name: Live Demo Stream
description: Streams players' views live from an instance to ql-stats-hub through a central relay, over a TLS tunnel on each host. Needs the relay set in Settings, the host's Demo Stream Tunnel on and a game server with the sv_demoStream cvars; each instance has a Live Demo Stream switch.

host_tunnel.description: Installs stunnel on this host and pins the stats-hub TLS certificate; save again with Enabled after the hub's certificate changes to re-pin it. Enabling lets this host's IP through the stats-hub firewall, and turning the tunnel off takes it out again unless the Telemetry Relay is still on.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Installs and starts the tunnel on this host.

fields.label: Local port
fields.description: Port the tunnel listens on at 127.0.0.1. Leave blank for 27999. After a change, save each instance's Live Demo Stream again so its server.cfg picks up the new port.

fields.label: Relay host for this host
fields.description: Where this host's tunnel connects instead of the relay in Settings, for a host that cannot reach it directly (e.g. a TCP relay on port 443 that forwards to stats-hub). Leave both relay fields blank to use Settings. stats-hub then sees the relay's address, so that address must be allowed in its firewall.

fields.label: Relay port for this host
fields.description: Port of the relay above, e.g. 443.

instance_stream.description: Streams this instance to stats-hub so spectators can watch it live. Switching it on or off applies the config and restarts the instance; changing only the delay does not.

fields.label: Stream this instance
fields.description: Needs the relay set in Settings and the Demo Stream Tunnel on this host.

fields.label: Delay (seconds)
fields.description: How far behind the live game viewers see it: 0 to 300, blank for the hub default.

settings.description: The relay every streaming instance connects to and the stats-hub that registers the streams. Independent of the telemetry-relay addon's stats-hub target.

fields.label: Relay host
fields.description: Hostname or IP the game servers can reach.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL
fields.description: Base URL the streams are registered against.

fields.label: Ingest token
fields.description: STATS_HUB_INGEST_TOKEN, not STATS_HUB_API_TOKEN. Never shown once saved; leave blank to keep the stored one.
